To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
P‐Nap‐treated oligdendrocytes exhibit GABA‐induced Ca2+ oscillations.
P‐Nap differentially modulated calcium responses of individual glial cells when exposed to GABA.
P‐NPA, a non‐physiological sialic acid, modulates calcium oscillations in cultured oligodendroglia.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of unnatural sialylation in the oligodendrogenic lineage and its influence on cell signalling pathways.
the influence of P‐NAP on calcium responses of oligodendrogliocytes.
the influence of P‐NAP on the calcium responses of oligodendrocyes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the incorporation of N‐propaneoylneuraminate into glycoproteins of oligodendrogliocytes leads to calcium oscillation upon the application of γ‐aminobutiric acid.
P‐Nap treatment of oligodendrogliocytes leads to calcium oscillation when GABA is applied.
the incorporation of N‐propanylneuraminyl‐containing sialic acids leads to calcium oscillation in oligodendroglioma cells upon the application of the neurotransmitter GABA.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the sialic acid composition of the cell membrane is an important determinant of the cellular response to neurotransmitters and that the sialylation of glycolipids and glycoproteins is involved in the control of the cellular calcium concentration.
sialic acid analogues can influence the calcium homeostasis of glial cells and that this effect is specific for the type of sialic acid used.
the calcium response to GABA is modulated by sialylation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the calcium oscillations are not only a result of the GABA receptor activation.
P‐Nap can be incorporated into glycoproteins in glial cells and that it has a significant effect on their calcium responses.
unnatural sialic acid can modulate the calcium responses of oligodendocytes to neurotransmitter GABA, and may therefore play a role in the regulation of calcium signaling in oligodendocytes.
